slides.title: Over half of kids see p*rn by 13. [[Most parents never talk about it.]]
slides.sub: What the research says — and what to say.

slides.title: By [[13]]
slides.body: In Common Sense Media's 2023 survey of U.S. teens, 54% had seen p*rn by age 13 — 15% at 10 or younger.

slides.title: Silence isn't [[protection]]
slides.body: If you don't talk about p*rn, the internet will teach your kid about it instead. The first conversation should come from you.

slides.title: Early exposure [[matters]]
slides.body: A University of Glasgow review linked earlier exposure to p*rn with more frequent use and a higher risk of compulsive use later. A link — not a certainty. Worth acting on.
